Commentary.Commentary: The chase is set to begin! Bangladesh fielders make their way out to the middle. Followed by Takudzwanashe Kaitano and Milton Shumba who will open for Zimbabwe. Some spin to start as Shakib Al Hasan has the new ball!

For Zimbabwe, it was a very tough innings with the ball. Only Richard Ngarava took a wicket and the rest of the bowlers except for Blessing Muzarabani were quite expensive. They also dropped catches to make things worse and towards the end, it seemed like their main motive was to stop the flow of runs rather than take wickets. Now, they need 477 to win the Test. It will be interesting to see how their openers set the tone for the last innings. Do join us in a short while as the hosts begin their chase!

After getting an initial lead of 192, Bangladesh would have wanted to put on a score which puts them well on top and almost guarantees that they cannot lose the game. Three batters batted for them and all of them put on a show. First Saif Hassan and Shadman Islam gave them a solid start. Saif was unlucky to miss out on his 50 but then Shadman carried on with Najmul Hossain Shanto. Both the left-handers got to their tons in style and they declared at 284, with a massive lead of 476.

A top session for Bangladesh! They have extended their lead by 361 runs. Both, Shadman Islam and Najmul Hossain Shanto are batting brilliantly. They lost the wicket of Saif Hasan in the middle but that hasn't stopped Bangladesh from chipping runs. Both the batters are playing proper cricketing shots and there have not been many loose shots. As far as Zimbabwe are concerned, their bowlers are not bowling in the arc. They got the solitary wicket of Saif Hassan, thanks to a brilliant catch at the gully region by Dion Myers. They had a chance to dismiss Shadman Islam but the catch was dropped at the point region. Overall, Zimbabwe will look to chip in regular wickets after lunch and stop Bangladesh to expand its lead. The second session of Day 4 will begin at 1210 local (1010 GMT). Do join us then.

We are all set to begin Day 4! The Zimbabwe players make their way out to the middle, followed by Saif Hassan and Shadman Islam. Donald Tiripano will start with the ball for Zimbabwe.

Pitch report - Tino Mawoyo says that there is an area on the pitch where there is very less grass and the ball can keep low. Adds that on Day 3, the ball was not turning. Adds that Zimbabwe will bat last on this pitch and it is not going to be easy. Tells that even the seamers are also getting the ball to misbehave.

Mehidy Hasan is there for a chat. He says that he is playing good and it is after a long time that he got a 5-wicket haul and he is very happy. Tells that he did not get any wickets in his first spell but he was not too disappointed and he remained patient. Tells that if he kept on bowling in the good areas, he would get wickets and he kept on discussing with the skipper. Adds that he kept bowling at the wickets and it worked. States that they have a good opportunity to win this game. Tells that Mahmudullah and Taskin played really well and he is really excited.

Stuart Matsikenyeri, the Zimbabwe batting coach, is there for a chat. He says that they had a decent start and the top order gave them what they are craving for but the collapse later on did not help their cause. Tells that they did not convert a couple of starts. Tells that they have the opportunity to look at a couple of guys. Goes onto say that Kaitano was brilliant as he showed patience with the bat and they batted over 100 overs which is positive. Tells that this is their time to get a big score but they are disappointed not to get one.

We have some news for you! Mahmudullah has announced his retirement from Test cricket and he passed on the information to his teammates just before the start of Day 3. Mahmudullah returned to Test cricket with a bang, scoring 150 and has ended his Test career with that. It is not official yet though and we will wait for the confirmation.

Hello and a warm welcome to the fourth day's play between Zimbabwe and Bangladesh. The visitors hold all the cards at the moment as they lead by 237 runs and they have all their wickets intact. They would look to get some quick runs and get a lead which is out of Zimbabwe's reach. The hosts, on the other hand, are in trouble and the only way they can come back in the game is by taking wickets and that too quickly. It looks quite difficult for them. Let's see how it pans out.
... Day 4, Session 1 ...

Right then! Bangladesh hold the upper hand in this game and they have been terrific. On Day 4, they would look to add some quick runs and put Zimbabwe out of the game. Zimbabwe, on the other hand, need to bundle Bangladesh out quickly. It won't be easy for them. Day 4 will be played on Saturday, 10th July 2021 at 0930 local (0730 GMT). Do join us then, cheers and take care.

Bangladesh are well on top. They had a slow start with the ball as they did not pick up many wickets in the first session but they came back really well in the second session as they kept on chipping away at the wickets. Mehidy Hasan was brilliant with another 5-fer to his name and he was well supported by Shakib Al Hasan and the seamers. Overall, it was a magnificent effort. Shadman Islam and Saif Hassan managed to see off the remaining few overs in the day.

Zimbabwe had a very good start with the bat, as they just lost one wicket in the first session but they struggled after the second session. They kept on losing wickets at regular intervals and they eventually folded up for 276, giving Bangladesh a lead of 192. Takudzwanashe Kaitano was the star of the show with the bat but he needed to go and score a big one while Brendan Taylor played a really good hand but both missed out on well-deserved centuries.

End of an excellent day for Bangladesh! After bowling out Zimbabwe for 276, they would have expected to survive till Stumps unscathed and Shadman Islam and Saif Hassan have done it well. Zimbabwe, on the other hand, had a disappointing day and they are way behind in the game. It is all Bangladesh at the moment.
